authoredFrom: ER-D32's edge half, found by the full-corpus dual lens on otp/lib/stdlib/test/epp_SUITE_data/mac2.erl. Ownership already fell back to the file path, but `currentSource` — which every file-scope edge reads its source from — fell back to the module name alone, and a module-less file has none. So the edge's source was undefined and pushRel dropped it silently: no error, no counter. The analyzer published four macro constants and their four `contains` edges, so it asserted the macros exist, and published nothing asserting they are used. Lines read off this file.
